assets.name: 인장
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE separate transparent Unity 2D equipment/inventory icon. INPUT ROLES: Image 1 (Player.png) is the authoritative CHARACTER/GEAR DESIGN reference: a faceless black hooded necromancer, ragged charcoal robe, little ivory skull/bone ornaments, an angular wood-and-bone staff with a luminous mint-green round orb. Image 2 is the approved wax-crayon ART STYLE reference. Image 3 is the approved magic BOOK shape/perspective reference, relevant only for book icons. Keep the already approved artwork style: thick rough black wax-crayon outline, naive chunky doodle silhouette, coarse scribbled flat-color fill with white pigment gaps, few broad interior strokes, no glossy 3D or smooth vector rendering. Gear must belong to the black-robed necromancer in image 1. Palette: charcoal/black/slate grey cloth, ivory bone, muted dark wood, mint green spectral magic. ONE object centered in square canvas, about 70 percent occupancy and clear margins, readable at 64px, genuine transparent alpha backdrop, clean transparent corners. No circular badges, frames, extra background objects, lettering or watermark. No school/office uniform, baseball cap, white shirt, red necktie, ID card, shiny gold jewelry, fancy medieval armor or generic wizard's pointy hat.
Subject: a compact magical SEAL / SIGNET artifact for the necromancer: one chunky dark-charcoal round stone token with a rough ivory skull carved on its face, two broad mint-green glowing crack strokes, a small simple bone rim. Show the front face with a slight depth at lower-right. This is a hand-held magical seal, no ring, no staff, no identification card, no writing or complex runes. Equipment object ONLY; do not draw a book.
